original_test_intent: Perform one approved BIOS upgrade or downgrade through the supported BMC WebUI and prove authenticated image acceptance, terminal progress, one expected BMC reset and recovered BIOS/host health.
original_method: Bind the target UI session and signed compatible image, preserve baseline, have an authorized operator submit once through the vendor page, monitor task/reset/console and verify the final BIOS, boot, device and log state.
manual_activity: The owner selects image/direction and recovery; an authorized operator verifies the UI session, image and target, submits once and supervises progress/reset/recovery while automation collects evidence.
required_inputs: Selected direction and signed BIOS image digest
Stable power, independent console and rollback/recovery
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval and target/image confirmation
Use trusted HTTPS and protect secrets/screenshots
Keep power stable and prohibit concurrent writes
Do not clear logs before baseline
Monitor UI/task, one reset, boot and device health
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, session, image, direction and compatibility
Preserve baseline and start reset/console monitoring
Assist evidence capture while operator executes documented UI flow
Verify one reset, BIOS version, boot, inventory and health
Do not click/confirm without owner scope, recover autonomously or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, direction, window and recovery
Verify UI target and perform/supervise confirmation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: HSC thermal workload belongs to duplicate row 779 and cannot flash or verify BIOS.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-documented BMC WebUI BIOS page with exact image type and progress/reset semantics; automation may capture and correlate but must not guess UI actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/downgrade, WebUI method, single-reset criterion, scripts and 15/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a target-verified baseline-upload-confirm-task-reset-recovery sequence with redacted UI evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds image authenticity, UI version/task semantics and full recovery validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; intended BIOS, one reset and restored platform health remain mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong session/image or power loss can make the system unbootable; UI state may be ambiguous without external console evidence.

project_override_considerations: The project may select one direction and UI version-specific workflow, but must document exact page/target/image, reset semantics and recovery; Redfish scripts are supporting references only if equivalent to the UI case is approved.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/UI identity, current/target BIOS and signed image digest
Redacted image selection/confirmation and task/progress timeline
Exactly one reset plus console/OOB readiness
Recovery record if invoked and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1501 consistently defines WebUI BIOS flashing; duplicate row 779 is isolated by variant and remains an HSC thermal case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Image, UI guide, approval, stable power and recovery are finite prerequisites; execution waits for them but is not permanently impossible.

review_improvement: Rejects the copied GPU workload and defines an attended, target-verified WebUI BIOS flash with one-reset and recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The UI action cannot be safely inferred or automated from a generic script, but its purpose and prerequisites are finite. Owner-controlled UI confirmation plus automated evidence collection fits REQUIRES and preserves the destructive boundary.
